title: dactylorhiza × conigera
intro: Dactylorhiza × conigera, commonly known as hybrid marsh orchid or hybrid spotted orchid, is a hybrid orchid species resulting from the cross between Dactylorhiza maculata and Dactylorhiza fuchsii. It is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × conigera include its potential as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, which may be useful in treating infections and soothing irritated skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
